enchantments.tooltip: +14 Enhancement Bonus: +14 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Negative Energy Absorption +35%: This effect absorbs 35% of all negative damage the character would have taken, after all other protections have been penetrated.
Negative Resistance +51: Passive: +51 Enhancement bonus to your Negative Resistance.
Blazing 14: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 14d6 Light damage on each critical hit.
Coruscating 6: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 6d6 Light damage on each hit.
